about_the_game:
Game Introduction

Welcome to "Fantasy! Summer Cook"! College student Li Lei takes a summer job at a coastal guesthouse to earn internship credits, expecting mundane tasks like hanging bedsheets and chopping watermelons. But his routine is turned upside down when he crosses paths with four unique female guests—an English teacher, a childhood friend, a quirky lolita, and a tsundere heiress. From comical mishaps to kitchen showdowns, a chaotic yet ultra-sweet summer rom-com kicks off!

Heroines' Profiles

▌ Han Meimei｜The Clumsy Teacher
Comedy Trait:
Outwardly a strict English tutor, secretly a complete mess in daily life.

▌ Xiaomei｜The Blunt Childhood Friend
Comedy Trait:
Self-proclaimed "sweet but not clueless" B&B expert. Draws smiley faces on fried eggs with ketchup—and crafts the ultimate [Tear-Inducing Confession Curry]!

▌ Chana｜The Prankster Fortune Teller
Comedy Trait:
Cosplay mastermind. Changes computer passwords to "Li Lei is a big dummy!" and loves cooking with insects.

▌ Liuli｜The Tsundere Heiress Makeover
Comedy Trait:
Arrives with a "weapons stash" to "experience commoner life." Orders you to do laundry, mop floors, and mow lawns.
